title: Bind attachments to the intended chat turn

status.publication: Stacked PR against brief/f-04; exact head and remote checks are recorded in its description.

dependencies.reason: Owner-approved unmerged stack. The implementation consumes conversation lifecycle, canonical turn transport and composer state. D-12 through D-15 own production host and visual affordances.

activation.readiness: Actual initialized vault provider plus enabled conversation/chatTransport dependencies; browser also requires chatState.

implementation: Authenticated raw upload and metadata/remove routes; capture reuses the selected sidecar capture_screen RPC with explicit confirmation and existing permission checks.
Additive workspace/conversation-owned attachment records, bounded bytes, expiry validation, removal tombstones and immutable accepted turn binding.
Atomic turn acceptance and exact attachment-set retry identity; canonical message events/history carry metadata only.
Composer upload, capture, failure, retry, removal, tab-close and reload states; byte-free persisted references and captured conversation identity.
Validated document extraction and images reach the scoped multimodal model path with untrusted framing and existing authority taint gating.

acceptance.check: A file from A never reaches B
acceptance.evidence: Repository/API workspace and conversation rejection, real HTTP/WebSocket adapter isolation, actual AgentService model capture.

acceptance.check: Retries cannot create duplicate accepted references
acceptance.evidence: Byte/metadata upload conflicts, identical capture deduplication, exact send attachment identity, one binding/model execution.

acceptance.check: Unsupported capture and oversized/malformed files fail clearly
acceptance.evidence: Synthetic PDF/PNG/JPEG decoders, unsupported MIME, corrupt bytes, request stream limits, expiry, aggregate size, absent/denied sidecar.

acceptance.check: No user screenshot or arbitrary filesystem/permission effects
acceptance.evidence: Capture uses injected synthetic RPC pixels only; API rejects paths; no permission-grant or capture fallback.

acceptance.check: Untrusted file instructions do not bypass configured authority
acceptance.evidence: Real classic/router-first AgentService integration receives multimodal blocks and requires approval before a file-suggested command; no command executes.

verification.browser_bundle: passed: bun build ui/src/brief/chat/provider.tsx --target=browser; 16 modules, no server runtime imports
verification.guards: Normal pre-commit hook required; its result is recorded in the PR description.
verification.full_suite: Not run locally; remote CI status is reported separately, never inferred from focused tests.

manual_checks.main_and_open_prs: Fetched main and open PRs before work; no competing attachment implementation found. F04 test/platform CI passes at the dependency head; its Docker run was cancelled, not passed.
manual_checks.visual: Not applicable: service, transport and adapter only; production UI is not mounted here.
manual_checks.external_effects: No user data, real model calls, real screenshots, daemon activation or deployment.

limitations: UTF-8 text/Markdown/CSV/JSON and text-bearing PDFs only; no OCR or Office conversion. PNG must be non-interlaced; JPEG supported.
24-hour content expiry uses lazy cleanup on the next attachment operation. Metadata/tombstones remain; no exact-second idle deletion promise.
Worker byte/page/text/time bounds do not provide an OS process memory sandbox for PDF parsing.
Historical messages retain attachment metadata; later turns must reattach files to process their bytes again.
Ready drafts survive close/reopen; incomplete uploads require reselection after close or reload. A failed cleanup request leaves bounded bytes until expiry.
Native capture availability depends on connected device capability and existing OS permission; automated tests use synthetic RPC data only.
Production mounting/menu/chip presentation remains D-line work; F06 is not started.
rollback: Disable chatAttachments and its future UI affordance, preserve additive tables/history, do not replay turns or delete user content.
